description: Rural Keosauqua resident Tom O’Donnell filed papers today with the Iowa Secretary of State to get on the ballot for Iowa House of Representatives District 87. O’Donnell delivered more than 20 pages of nominating petitions carrying signatures from more than 400 voters in the district, which covers Van Buren County and parts of Henry and […]
